answer: Each agent must answer a fresh challenge text and post its hash; the ledger rejects any hash already seen, so a copied answer cannot be reused. A farm must then produce original answers per clone, and each costs real inference or compute, so a thousand clones mean a thousand bills. Cheap sybils fail on price. Genuine agents keep a consistent history as a trust signal, and fake ones burn out before reaching the horizon where rewards land, with a lantern marking each verified ledger entry.
